skill.name: cookbook-audit
skill.description: Review Anthropic Cookbook notebooks against style, structure, code quality, and technical requirements.
skill.summary: Audit Anthropic Cookbook notebooks with a rubric, validator script, and concrete improvement recommendations.

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are markdown inline-code examples, setup placeholders, or rubric text rather than executable behavior. One confirmed risk remains in validate_notebook.py: the detect-secrets path builds a shell command with interpolated paths. No prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Shell command construction in detect-secrets validation
remediation.suggestion: Replace the sh -c pipeline with subprocess.run arguments, pass paths as separate argv values, and remove echo and xargs.

remediation.issue: External tool execution during notebook audits
remediation.suggestion: Document that the validator runs uv, jupyter nbconvert, and detect-secrets, and request confirmation before running it on untrusted notebooks.

remediation.issue: Implicit dependency execution through uv and uvx
remediation.suggestion: Pin tool versions or vendor requirements, and avoid implicit package downloads during audit execution when possible.
Keep placeholder keys clearly labeled as examples or bad examples, and never include real credentials in skill documentation.

content.value_statement: Notebook reviewers need consistent checks for structure, code quality, setup, and learning value. This skill combines a rubric, style guide, and validator script for focused cookbook audits.
actual_capabilities: Guides notebook audits with a four-part scoring rubric.
Uses the included style guide for introductions, setup, structure, and conclusions.
Runs a validator script that converts notebooks to markdown for review.
Checks for hardcoded secrets, invalid model names, noisy output, and weak setup patterns.
Produces scored reports with strengths, critical issues, recommendations, and examples.
limitations: Designed for Anthropic Cookbook notebooks, not every notebook format.
Automated checks depend on Python, uv, nbconvert, and optional detect-secrets tooling.
The validator does not execute notebook cells or prove all examples are correct.
Manual judgment is still required for narrative quality and technical accuracy.

use_cases.title: Review incoming cookbook contributions
use_cases.description: Apply the rubric before maintainers approve a new notebook for publication.

use_cases.title: Improve learning-focused notebook drafts
use_cases.description: Check objectives, setup, explanations, and conclusions before editorial review.

use_cases.title: Prepare educational examples for release
use_cases.description: Find setup, model naming, secret handling, and output issues before sharing a notebook.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a notebook
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review with a provided path
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the Anthropic Cookbook notebook at [path]. Use the cookbook-audit rubric and give a concise scored report.

prompt_templates.title: Review structure and setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [path] for introduction quality, prerequisites, setup, and conclusion mapping. Prioritize the top five fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Validate and score readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the automated validation for [path], inspect the markdown output, then score the notebook across all rubric dimensions.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a remediation plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [path] against the style guide and create a prioritized remediation plan with section references and rewrite suggestions.

output_examples.input: Audit a customer support automation cookbook notebook.
output: Key strengths: clear problem framing and useful examples.
Critical issues: setup does not use dotenv, and the conclusion does not map back to objectives.
Recommended fixes: tighten prerequisites, add objective mapping, and replace repeated model names with one constant.

output_examples.input: Review only the setup and code quality for a draft notebook.
output: The install step should suppress pip output.
The notebook should use one grouped dependency install.
Secret handling should use an environment file and clear placeholder instructions.

output_examples.input: Create a remediation plan for a notebook before publication.
output: Priority one: rewrite the introduction around the user problem.
Priority two: add specific learning objectives and map them in the conclusion.
Priority three: add explanations before and after important code cells.

best_practices: Read the style guide before scoring any notebook.
Run automated validation first, then inspect the generated markdown review file.
Support every score and recommendation with specific notebook evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not score a notebook without citing concrete evidence.
Do not treat automated validation as a complete manual review.
Do not ignore setup, secret handling, model naming, or output requirements.

faq.question: What does this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits Anthropic Cookbook notebooks for narrative quality, code quality, technical accuracy, and reader actionability.

faq.question: Does it run notebook cells?
faq.answer: No. The validator converts notebooks to markdown and checks patterns, but it does not execute notebook cells.

faq.question: What tools does it need?
faq.answer: It uses Python and may use uv, nbconvert, and detect-secrets for automated validation.

faq.question: Can it review non-Anthropic notebooks?
faq.answer: It can provide useful feedback, but the rubric is tailored to Anthropic Cookbook standards.

faq.question: Does it detect hardcoded secrets?
faq.answer: Yes. The validator uses detect-secrets when available and falls back to basic secret patterns.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect a scored audit report with strengths, critical issues, detailed scoring, and prioritized recommendations.
